title: Copyable Values, Clone Chains, and Legend Rule Non-Sacrifice

cited_rules.summary: Layer 1 applies copy effects modifying copiable values before later layers.
Legend rule SBA: if a player controls two or more legendary permanents with the same name, they choose one and put the rest into their owners' graveyards (not a sacrifice).
Copying an object acquires its copiable values (printed values as modified by other copy effects), excluding Layer 7c buffs like Giant Growth.
A copy's copiable values become the copied information, so copying a Clone copies what that Clone copied.

provenance.source_summary: Core Layer 1 copy-effect stress benchmark covering non-copyable Layer 7c buffs, Clone-of-a-Clone chains, and Legend Rule SBA non-sacrifice semantics.
provenance.scope_notes: Preemptive benchmark authored before full Layer 1 copy replacement and Legend Rule SBA hooks land.

cases.name: Clone copying a Giant Growth'd Grizzly Bears enters as 2/2
cases.summary: Grizzly Bears gets +3/+3 in Layer 7c to become 5/5; Clone enters copying Grizzly Bears and becomes a 2/2 Bear, not a 5/5.

action.description: P1 casts Giant Growth on Grizzly Bears.
Giant Growth resolves; Grizzly Bears is now 5/5.
P1 casts Clone choosing to enter as a copy of Grizzly Bears.
Clone enters copying Grizzly Bears' copiable values only.

invariants.description: Continuous P/T modifications from Layer 7c are excluded from copiable values.

cases.name: Clone copying own Ragavan triggers Legend Rule without sacrificing
cases.summary: Clone enters as a copy of Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer; Legend Rule SBA puts one into the graveyard without sacrificing it, so Mayhem Devil does not trigger.

action.description: P1 casts Clone entering as a copy of Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer.
Clone resolves and Legend Rule SBA sends the duplicate to graveyard.

invariants.description: Putting an extra legendary permanent into its owner's graveyard under the legend rule is not a sacrifice and never triggers sacrifice abilities.
